svg.title: Temperature and optimal boundary allocation in an exact insulation benchmark

cc:Work.dc:title: Temperature and optimal boundary allocation in an exact insulation benchmark
cc:Work.dc:description: Exact manufactured unit-square benchmark from Antil, Kaltenbach and Kirk, arXiv:2606.14991 Section 7.1. Blue shading shows temperature; orange exterior widths are proportional to the exact normal insulation allocation, with schematic corner joins.
